convert_to_choe_charniak: convert a tree representation file to Choe-Charniak format with typed closing non-terminals
convert_with_preterms: convert a tree file with preterminals (POS tags) to Choe-Charniak format
convert_untyped_closing: convert a tree file to Choe-Charniak format using untyped closing non-terminal X
run_cli_conversion: run the convert_to_choe_charniak CLI tool to transform input tree file to output format
transform_s_nps_vps: transform S NP VP tree structures into Choe-Charniak style with closing non-terminals
